hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); PROMPT=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('prompt',''))" 2>/dev/null); case "$PROMPT" in /powerhouse-knowledge:*|/seed*|/extract*|/connect*|/synthesize*|/verify*|/pipeline*|/health*|/graph*|/search*|/setup*|/import*|/export*|/watch*|/projects*|/skills*|/cli-reference*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; which switchboard >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'WARNING: switchboard CLI not found — install: curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/liberuum/switchboard-cli/main/install.sh | bash'; exit 0; }; switchboard ping 2>&1 | head -1; switchboard models list --format json 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'bai/' || switchboard introspect 2>&1 | tail -1; switchboard config show 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(f'Profile: {d.get(\"name\",\"unknown\")} -> {d.get(\"url\",\"unknown\")}')" 2>/dev/null; switchboard auth status --format json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(f'Signing: on as {d.get(\"app_name\")} ({d.get(\"did\",\"\")[:24]}…) for {d.get(\"address\")}' + (' — WARNING: Renown credential expired; run ph login' if d.get('credential_expired') else '')) if d.get('signing') else print('WARNING: no signing identity on this profile — vault writes are BLOCKED until: ph login && switchboard auth login --renown' if 'signing' in d else 'WARNING: switchboard CLI < 1.0.34 — run: switchboard update (signed writes required)')" 2>/dev/null; switchboard drives list --format json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import json,sys; drives=json.load(sys.stdin); m=[d for d in drives if any(n.get('documentType')=='bai/vault-config' for n in d.get('state',{}).get('global',{}).get('nodes',[]))]; print(f'VAULT_DRIVE_SLUG={m[0][\"slug\"]}\nVAULT_DRIVE_ID={m[0][\"id\"]}') if m else print('NOTE: no vault drive found on this profile — ask the user which vault to use')" 2>/dev/null; [ -n "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" ] && node "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/build-agent.mjs" --check >/dev/null 2>&1 || { [ -n "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" ] && echo 'WARNING: agents/knowledge-agent.md is stale — run: node scripts/build-agent.mjs'; }
